next/babel.reason: vinext uses Vite and does not provide Next.js's Babel preset entrypoint

next/client.reason: Internal Next.js client module (emitter, hydrate, initialize, router, version), not a public API

next/app.reason: next/app is a Pages Router entrypoint that vinext does not emulate as a standalone runtime module

next/experimental/testing/server.reason: Experimental testing helpers are outside vinext's compatibility target

next/experimental/testmode/playwright.reason: Experimental Playwright helpers are outside vinext's compatibility target

next/experimental/testmode/playwright/ms.reason: Experimental Playwright/MSW helpers are outside vinext's compatibility target

next/experimental/testmode/proxy.reason: Experimental testmode proxy helpers are outside vinext's compatibility target

next/navigation.reason: Error rethrowing and action error detection not yet implemented

next/router.reason: Router named export and legacy utilities (createRouter, makePublicRouterInstance, withRouter) not yet exported

next/server.reason: ImageResponse is in next/og shim but not re-exported from next/server yet

next/dynamic.reason: noSSR standalone function not yet exported (ssr:false option works via dynamic())

next/cache.reason: Deprecated aliases for cacheLife/cacheTag not yet exported
